in_marathi.name: Sarmistha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarmistha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sarmistha means the one who is possessed with wisdom and knowledge. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sar' meaning 'all' and 'mistha' meaning 'well-established'. Sarmistha is often considered as the goddess of wisdom and knowledge.
